title: Peruvian Stew with Carrots and Beef
description: A hearty Peruvian stew made with tender beef, sweet carrots, and a hint of spice.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the stew, potatoes, and carrots. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
